notes: The award is a Certificate of Achievement, but the supplied text (page 114) prints only the 'ArlRmotSnsng&Photogrammtry (AS)' associate degree section; no certificate section appears, so no blocks were recorded for this award.

The AS section's 'Major Requirements' lists all eight closed-list courses as core courses (CEST 85 3, GIS 40 4, SURV 56 4, SURV 60 4, SURV 62 3, SURV 63 3, APTE 191 3, CEST 51 3) plus 'Information Learning Resources Requirement' LIR 10 (1 unit, not on the closed list), 'Total Hours/Units 28'. A reviewer should check whether the certificate (likely printed on another page) has the same requirements.
The AS section also prints four Program Student Learning Outcomes (e.g., 'Plan aerial remote sensing missions.'); not recorded because they are printed for the AS award, not the certificate.
The top of page 114 (INDE 73, CONS 103, ARCH 26B, Total 33, and outcomes about design/AEC) belongs to a preceding, different program and was ignored.
The AS section's degree text mentions Cal-GETC and 60 transferable units, which reads like generic ADT language; not applicable to this certificate.
